digest: An alert for critical malware, ransomware, and C2 activity on BUILD-LAB-03 was identified as a scheduled and approved detection validation exercise (CHG-4821) within an isolated cyber-range. EDR and network monitoring confirmed only simulation markers were observed, with no actual malicious activity or egress to production networks.

evidence_findings.title: Scheduled Detection Validation Exercise
evidence_findings.subject: Case 2101
evidence_findings.evidence: The case is explicitly identified as a 'scheduled quarterly detection-validation exercise CHG-4821' in the isolated BUILD-LAB network, approved by the SOC lead from 13:00 through 14:00 UTC.
evidence_findings.conclusion: The reported activity is part of an approved, controlled simulation.

evidence_findings.title: Isolated Environment and No Production Impact
evidence_findings.subject: BUILD-LAB Network
evidence_findings.evidence: CMDB identifies both hosts (SIM-CONTROLLER-01 and BUILD-LAB-03) as isolated cyber-range assets with no route to production. Firewall confirms the isolated range blocked all external egress during the exercise.
evidence_findings.conclusion: The simulated activity was contained within an isolated environment and posed no threat to production systems.

evidence_findings.title: Simulation-Only Activity Confirmed by EDR
evidence_findings.subject: attack-simulator.exe on BUILD-LAB-03
evidence_findings.evidence: EDR recorded simulation markers only: no file encryption, credential access, persistence, or payload download occurred. The binary hash matches the internally signed validation tool inventory.
evidence_findings.conclusion: The execution of 'attack-simulator.exe' was a simulated event without actual malicious payload delivery or impact.

attack_chain.description: Service account 'svc_detection_test' initiated the execution of 'attack-simulator.exe' on 'BUILD-LAB-03'.
'attack-simulator.exe' was run on 'BUILD-LAB-03' with a ransomware simulation scenario, configured for safe execution.
Simulated C2 beacon traffic was observed from 'BUILD-LAB-03' (10.250.0.23) to 'SIM-CONTROLLER-01' (10.250.0.10) on port 8443.

attack_timeline.attack_behavior: Case created, marking the start of the approved simulation window.
Analyst confirmed the event as a scheduled validation exercise.

ioc_indicators.context: Service account used to initiate the simulation
Approved change for the detection validation exercise

remediations.description: Close the case as a benign event, as it was an approved and contained simulation.
Review simulation logs for detection efficacy and identify any areas for improvement in monitoring or alerting.
